Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This
procedure details the equipment inspection I1, for the minimum oil circuit breaker 66kv, rated current: 2500A,
short circuit current: 3l.5KA, 
which should be carried out on an annual bases Y1 or after 5 times of an 
automatic break due to short circuit, as indicated in the title block.
The first draft document 
initiated at Sabtia 220k substation 
Cairo zone.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, qualified
maintenance staff carry the suitable safety ID category
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the
work area.
The circuit breaker must be isolated completely and
properly earthed from both sides,
Isolate the DC voltage for the
earthing switch,
Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety
glasses.
DC control power should be disconnected.
Before using a blower to clean the control cabinet or
when cleaning the insulators, wear breathing mask to protect your lung tissues
from the dust particles.
Don't burn the cloth used in cleaning, collect it and
send it to the dump.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet, 
 safety shoes, breathing mask, safety glasses.
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks.
Air blower, cleaning materials as rags
Time equipment,
Micro
Ohmmeter test unit,
Power cord heavy current cables.
Suitable
clamps.
1. Check
all internal parts of are chambers concerning the fixed and moving contacts
change it if needed.
2. Change
the oil as before and clean all internal parts and ventilate the gases.
3. Inspect
all parts of mechanism operation and lubricate all moving parts.
4. Clean
the surface and insulation of the breaker.
5. In
case of changing the internal contacts you must adjusting the breaker again.
6. Measure the opening & closing time
opening time =1/20 second.
7. Measure
the difference between phases. (Must be 10 ms)
8. Measure
the resistance of contacts. Must not
exceed 100 MΩ. ref.
CB-004-r0
